parsed.name: 数字示波器
parsed.description: Rigol DS1052E 是一款台式数字示波器，用于观察和测量电压随时间变化的波形。它常用于电子实验与调试，帮助用户分析信号幅度、频率、时序、噪声和瞬态行为。
parsed.description_en: The Rigol DS1052E is a benchtop digital oscilloscope used to view and measure voltage waveforms over time. It is commonly used in electronics labs and debugging to analyze signal amplitude, frequency, timing, noise, and transient behavior.

actions.description: 向示波器发送查询命令并读取返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send a query command to the oscilloscope and read back the response.
